EN: That doesn't even make sense!
ZH: 那个简直不像话！

EN: Oh, hi there! Wasn't expecting to meet anyone today.
ZH: 哦，你好呀。还以为今天不会有人来拜访我呢。

EN: We just found this great Giddyup Buttercup! We're...
ZH: 我们刚发现了一匹超棒的奶油小马！我们……

EN: Why are you looking at me like that?
ZH: 为什么用那种眼光看着我？

EN: Oh, no - you are NOT taking this!
ZH: 哦，不，你不能拿走这个！

EN: Hand over the toy.
ZH: 把玩具交过来。

EN: This is a one-horse town, buddy.
ZH: 兄弟，整个小镇就只有这一匹马。

EN: Drop the reins and step away.
ZH: 放下绳子，站远点。

EN: Give it up, or it's off to the glue factory for you.
ZH: 放弃吧，不然下一个进胶水工厂的就是你！

EN: Will you use it for spare parts, or riding in your spare time? Up to you, you're the Overseer. Send Dwellers to get one!
ZH: 你想用它来制造零件，还是在闲暇时间骑一骑？你说得算，谁让你是监督者。派你的居民们去弄一匹回来。

EN: My Metal Pony
ZH: 我的小铁马

EN: Find a Giddyup Buttercup.
ZH: 寻找奶油小马。

EN: Find a Giddyup Buttercup.
ZH: 寻找奶油小马。

EN: What better way to learn about the deadly Glowing Radscorpion than first-hand observation? Send your research team to the monster's lair. Of course, you'll need to kill it first.
ZH: 想要研究发光辐射蝎的致死性，有什么比亲自观察更好呢？派遣你的研究队深入怪兽洞穴吧。当然你得先杀了它。

EN: My Weird Science Project
ZH: 奇怪的科学项目

EN: Eliminate the Glowing Radscorpion.
ZH: 消灭发光辐射蝎。

EN: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion in the name of science!
ZH: 以科学之名消灭发光辐射蝎！

EN: Some slick raiders breached our vault and made off with critical supplies. We traced them to an abandoned Vault-Tec site near the Strip.
ZH: 一伙狡猾的掠夺者闯进我们的避难所，偷走了关键物资。我们一路追踪，追到新维加斯大道附近一座废弃的避难所科技基地。

EN: The Mother of All Brains
ZH: 众脑之母

EN: Confront the thieves' leader
ZH: 与窃贼首领对峙

EN: Uncover the true nature of the thieves
ZH: 揭开窃贼的真面目

EN: Reclaim our supplies
ZH: 夺回我们的物资

EN: Hunt the bandits. End their thievery.
ZH: 追捕那群匪徒。终结他们的偷窃行径。

EN: Scanning... Vault-Tec Identification… Access granted.
ZH: 正在扫描……避难所科技身份识别……验证通过。

EN: Experiment "Molespy" failure. Hostile creatures have taken over the building.
ZH: 实验“鼹鼠间谍”失败。敌对生物已占领整栋建筑。

EN: Cannot comply. Resident mutated Mole rats control the facility.
ZH: 无法照办。变异鼹鼠居民控制着该设施。

EN: “Stuff” undefined. “Brigands” undefined. Facility overrun by intelligent Mole rats.
ZH: “东西”未定义。“强盗”未定义。设施已被高智商的鼹鼠占据。

EN: Tell me more about this outbreak!
ZH: 给我讲讲这次爆发的事！

EN: Seal the building. Flood it with toxic gasses.
ZH: 封锁大楼。释放毒气淹没它。

EN: Have you seen a group of brigands carrying a bunch of stuff?
ZH: 你见过一群扛着一堆东西的强盗吗？

EN: Alert: it has been <1> day since last subject breakout!
ZH: 警报：距上次受试者逃跑已过去<1>天！

EN: Who wanders woefully within our walls?
ZH: 谁人凄凄惨惨漫步于吾辈之墙垣？

EN: Better believe we bite back.
ZH: 你最好相信，吾辈定当反咬。

EN: Invaders' insults instigate immediate intervention.
ZH: 入侵者之侮辱定招即刻之制裁。

EN: Rational retorts reap its reward. Roam restraintlessly.
ZH: 理智之对答必有厚报。请畅行无阻。

EN: Holy Overseer! A talking Molerat! Can I pet you?
ZH: 天哪，监督者在上！会说话的鼹鼠！我能摸摸你吗？

EN: This ain't right. Vermin shouldn't talk.
ZH: 这可不对。害虫不该会说话。

EN: We will wander where we want, wannabe wombat!
ZH: 我们爱去哪儿就去哪儿，你这只自命不凡的袋熊！

EN: Mother's mercy!
ZH: 母亲的慈悲！

EN: Silly squad sniffing for our stash? Stop swiftly or suffer slaughter
ZH: 愚蠢小队嗅来嗅去找吾等之藏货？速速停手，否则休怪吾等大开杀戒！

EN: Barbarian brutality!
ZH: 野蛮残暴！

EN: This token testifies to our thirst for tranquility. Take it and turn tail.
ZH: 此物印证吾等对安宁之渴望。拿上它，速速掉头滚蛋。

EN: Relentless resistance requires a rebutal.
ZH: 顽固之抵抗必遭吾等严词反击。

EN: So you admit guilt? Time to carve some Molerat steak!
ZH: 所以你们认罪了？是时候切点鼹鼠肉排了！

EN: Want us gone? Tell us where to find our stuff.
ZH: 想让我们走？告诉我们东西在哪。

EN: Err... Beat it brood babies! This band will bust your base! See?
ZH: 呃……滚开，一窝崽子！我们要端了你们的老巢！听见没？

EN: There is a terminal in here.
ZH: 这里有一台终端机。

EN: <Search for info>
ZH: <搜索情报>

EN: Mole rats got brain implants. Failed as spies, but turned into thieves.
ZH: 鼹鼠被植入了大脑芯片。间谍是当不成了，却沦为窃贼。

EN: Getting rid of the brood mother should end their mischief. But there's more...
ZH: 除掉育母应该就能终结它们的恶行。但还有更多……

EN: <Read about other failed experiments>
ZH: <阅读其他失败实验的记录>

EN: More facilities to shut down? Let's finish here and investigate.
ZH: 还有更多设施要关闭？先解决这里，再去调查。

EN: Hey! Caps, junk, outfits. Our stolen stuff is here. Let's grab it and leave.
ZH: 嘿！瓶盖、杂物、装备。我们被偷的东西在这儿。拿了就走。

EN: Wait! Are Mole rats rodents?
ZH: 等等！鼹鼠算啮齿动物吗？

EN: Still gotta put a stop to these rodents, though...
ZH: 不过还是得把这群啮齿鼠辈收拾了……

EN: Behold the brainiac brood mother! Bow before your better.
ZH: 瞻仰智力超群之育母吧！向你的尊长俯首称臣。

EN: Pitiful pun proves your poor perspicacity. Prepare to perish.
ZH: 拙劣之谐音恰证尔等洞察之匮乏。准备受死吧。

EN: A vitriolic vindication of our violence versus villains.
ZH: 这是对吾等向恶徒施加正义惩戒的辛辣辩白。

EN: Stay silent, sinister strangers, and succumb to our strike!
ZH: 闭嘴吧，阴险的陌生人，在吾等的猛击下受死！

EN: Fancy speech for what amounts to a quaint group of bandits! Mole-pi-rats?
ZH: 对于一帮微不足道的匪徒团伙来说，这番说辞未免太高雅了吧！叫你们“鼹盗”如何？

EN: The novelty of talking Mole rats has worn off. Time for some pest control.
ZH: 会说话的鼹鼠这股新鲜劲已经过去了。该灭鼠了。

EN: Man! I'm trying to match your speech, but alliterations are hard!
ZH: 老天！我想学你的说话方式，可头韵真难！

EN: When we shut down the Molerat gang, we uncovered a series of failed experiments, each one a threat the security of New Vegas. The next one concerns Ghouls.
ZH: 当我们捣毁鼹鼠帮派时，我们发现了一系列失败实验，每一个都威胁着新维加斯的安全。下一个实验与尸鬼有关。

EN: One of Us
ZH: 我们中的一员

EN: Put an end to unity
ZH: 终结心智统一

EN: Investigate the Vault-Tec Ghoul mind-control experiment
ZH: 调查避难所科技的尸鬼精神控制实验

EN: Welcome! We are one. Listen to our voice. Speak to our collective mind.
ZH: 欢迎！我们是一体的。聆听我们的声音。与我们共同的思想对话。

EN: Please address us when you speak about us! We are peace incarnate. Case in point: you may pass.
ZH: 在谈论我们时，请直接对我们说！我们就是和平的化身。举个例子：你可以通过。

EN: We ended envy. We erased strife. Is that failure? We worried about what you deem success.
ZH: 我们消除了嫉妒。我们抹去了纷争。这算失败吗？我们倒担心你们所谓的成功。

EN: Oh, naive child of discord! If only you had tasted our serenity.
ZH: 哦，天真的纷争之子！你若能尝到我们的宁静该多好。

EN: What the heck? Did these Ghouls grow a hivemind?
ZH: 搞什么鬼？这些尸鬼长出集体意识了？

EN: Pfft… Another failed experiment, I see.
ZH: 切……我看又是一次失败实验。

EN: Groupthink! This must be a commie's ploy! To arms!
ZH: 集体思维！这肯定是共产主义的阴谋！准备战斗！

EN: Stop the assault. Join us. We have fresh meat.
ZH: 停止进攻。加入我们吧。我们有新鲜肉。

EN: Bob is meat. You are meat. We are meat. Let us show you.
ZH: 鲍勃是肉。你是肉。我们是肉。让我们给你看看。

EN: Loneliness is a fate worse than death. We will grant you peace, and bolster our pantry.
ZH: 孤独是比死亡更糟的命运。我们会赐予你安宁，同时充实我们的食物储备。

EN: Then we'll quell the turbulence, and add you to the meat reserve.
ZH: 那我们会平息这份躁动，把你加进肉库。

EN: Is the fresh meat Bob? He went missing near here.
ZH: 那新鲜肉是鲍勃吗？他在附近失踪了。

EN: Sure let's have a barbecue, as you strip us of what makes us unique!
ZH: 好啊，来吧，一边烧烤，一边剥夺我们独一无二的东西！

EN: You wouldn't want my mind in your mix. It's… disturbed.
ZH: 你不会想让我这样的头脑混进你们的。它……不太正常。

EN: Please, hear us out. Don't you seek freedom from anxiety? No more hatred. No more resentment.
ZH: 请听我们说完。你难道不寻求摆脱焦虑的自由吗？不再有仇恨。不再有怨恨。

EN: Boring? When every voice sings in unison? Think on it, wanderer.
ZH: 无聊？当每一道声音齐声唱和，还会无聊？想想吧，旅人。

EN: Oh… well, truthfully, we didn't expect a yes. Give us a day to… consider.
ZH: 哦……好吧，说实话，我们没想到会得到肯定的回答。给我们一天……考虑一下。

EN: Must be boring being you then.
ZH: 那你们自己肯定很无聊。

EN: You know what? You make a good case. Where do I sign?
ZH: 你知道吗？你说得有理。在哪签字？

EN: Let's see if you still feel nothing when you're full of lead.
ZH: 我倒要看看，等你吃满铅弹，还会不会心如止水。

EN: Did you know: 75% of wastelanders fantasize about Ghouls? Become part of a post-nuclear harem, like us.
ZH: 你知道吗：75%的废土人都幻想过尸鬼？像我们一样，加入一个核后时代的后宫吧。

EN: That's because you've never been to one of our soirées. Your loss.
ZH: 那是因为你从没参加过我们的沙龙。亏大了。

EN: Division. Dissension. Enjoy your touchless minority.
ZH: 分裂。异议。享受你那无人触碰的少数派地位吧。

EN: There is no end to us, as we are many.
ZH: 我们数不胜数，永远不会被终结。

EN: I'll pass. My love life doesn't involve irradiated flesh.
ZH: 我算了。我的感情生活可不牵扯辐射皮肉。

EN: Guess I'm in the other 25%. No thanks.
ZH: 看来我是另外那25%。谢了，不了。

EN: You're really pushing this sales pitch. You know we're here to end you, right?
ZH: 你这推销词可真是穷追不舍。你知道我们是来终结你们的，对吧？

EN: Raaaaaaaagh!
ZH: 啊啊啊啊啊！

EN: Is that a wild Deathclaw? Or part of the hivemind? No matter: it's charging!
ZH: 那是只野生死爪？还是集体意识的一部分？管他呢：它冲过来了！

EN: Join our community. We are the ultimate state of the free man.
ZH: 加入我们的社群。我们就是自由人的终极形态。

EN: We can resolve this, by eating YOUR brain!
ZH: 我们有办法解决，只要吃掉你的大脑！

EN: Typical self-centered mindset. Get rid of that self. Here, we will help you.
ZH: 典型的自我中心思维。去掉那个自我吧。来，我们帮你。

EN: Uh-oh… collective brain spilled the beans?
ZH: 哎呀……集体大脑说漏嘴了？

EN: Does this thing have a mute button? I am growing tired of your nagging.
ZH: 这东西有静音键吗？我受够你的唠叨了。

EN: We are definitely NOT an experiment controlled by a computer.
ZH: 我们绝对不是由电脑控制的实验品。

EN: This computer looks suspicious. Let's hack it!
ZH: 这台电脑看起来很可疑。我们来入侵它！

EN: That'll keep them busy till oblivion. Let's bail.
ZH: 那能让它们一直忙到毁灭。我们撤吧。

EN: There is a note: <Detonation will occur after departure.> Lucky us!
ZH: 有张便条：<我们离开后将会引爆。>我们可真走运！

EN: It reads <Subjects severed from the collective. Silence and despair imminent.> Our job here is done!
ZH: 上面写着<受试者已脱离集体。即将陷入沉默与绝望。>我们的任务完成了！

EN: <Choose option: pit half against the other half>
ZH: <选择选项：让一半去对付另一半>

EN: <Press the button marked BOOM>
ZH: <按下标着BOOM（爆炸）的按钮>

EN: <Select Individualistic Mode>
ZH: <选择“个人主义模式”>

EN: I see. The Ghouls are networked through this computer. What's our play?
ZH: 我明白了。尸鬼是通过这台电脑联网的。我们该怎么办？

EN: Next on our list of failed experiments to shut down: Vault Tech has unleashed the subversive power of philosophy. Everyone's sanity is at risk.
ZH: 接下来要关闭的失败实验：避难所科技释放了颠覆性的哲学力量。所有人的理智都危在旦夕。

EN: War of the Wits
ZH: 智斗之战

EN: Prove your superior intellect… or gunslinging
ZH: 证明你卓越的智力……或枪法

EN: Settle an existential dispute
ZH: 解决一场存在主义纷争

EN: Share your view on war
ZH: 分享你对战争的看法

EN: Meet with the "philosophes" and show them what real life is about!
ZH: 去见见那些“哲学家”，让他们见识见识什么是真实的生活！

EN: Please do not squash us. We are sentient just like you.
ZH: 请不要踩扁我们。我们和你们一样有知觉。

EN: We have no knowledge of "car tunes". But we hope it makes you merciful. Does it?
ZH: 我们不知道什么是“动画骗”。但我们希望它能让你手下留情。会吗？

EN: Ah! To perish as the victim of human aesthetic prejudice!
ZH: 啊！死于人类的审美偏见，真是可悲！

EN: Here. You humans cherish useless drinking container leftovers, correct?
ZH: 给。你们人类珍惜那些没用的饮料容器残骸，对吧？

EN: First Mole rats, now Radroaches? Vault-Tec's trying to turn the wasteland into a cartoon?
ZH: 先是鼹鼠，现在又是辐射蟑螂？避难所科技想把废土变成动画片？

EN: Sorry! Should've been born cute and cuddly.
ZH: 抱歉！你们就该生得可爱又软萌。

EN: Maybe... if you can give us something that isn't crap.
ZH: 也许吧……如果你能给我们点不那么垃圾的东西。

EN: We savor life. We fear suffering. Same as you.
ZH: 我们珍视生命。我们畏惧痛苦。和你们一样。

EN: Invaders. We are dedicated to peace and the pursuit of ideas.
ZH: 入侵者。我们致力于和平与追求思想。

EN: Why is it that higher intelligence often leads to cruelty?
ZH: 为什么更高的智慧往往会走向残忍？

EN: Your wars left the world mostly empty. We mean no harm. You can move freely.
ZH: 你们的战争让世界几乎空无一物。我们无意伤害。你们可以自由活动。

EN: We do have a small number of bottles preseved here. Is that serendipidy?
ZH: 我们这儿确实保存着少量瓶子。这算不算巧合？

EN: Because it's fun! It goes "swissh" and then there's bug juice everywhere. Let's get stomping.
ZH: 因为有趣！咻地一声，然后虫汁溅得到处都是。来来来，开踩了。

EN: You speak of peace, but the way you breed, how long before you need more space? Our space?
ZH: 你说和平，可照你们这繁殖速度，过多久你们就会需要更多空间？我们的空间？

EN: Here is an “idea”: give me Nuka Cola Quantum or die!
ZH: 这里有个“思想”：给我量子核子可乐，否则就死！

EN: Why are your fouling our grounds with those death-dealing boots?
ZH: 你们为什么穿着那双杀人靴子玷污我们的土地？

EN: The necessities of war lead to our creation. So tell us…
ZH: 战争的迫切需要催生了我们。所以告诉我们……

EN: Ah! The inescapability of our fate as war machines, how ever much we despise it.
ZH: 啊！无论我们多么厌恶，作为战争机器的命运都无可避免。

EN: A hedonist and a sadist. This day is one of doom for us.
ZH: 一个享乐主义者加一个施虐狂。今天对我们来说注定是末日。

EN: Extortion... how... human of you!
ZH: 敲诈勒索……多……像人类的行为！

EN: I heard war never changes. But talking Radroaches? That's a change we can't stomach.
ZH: 我听人说战争永不变。但会说话的辐射蟑螂？这种变化我们可受不了。

EN: War is fun! Like… we are about to go to war with you, and we will have fun doing it.
ZH: 战争很有趣！就像……我们马上要跟你们开战了，而且我们会乐在其中。

EN: Pay tribute and you'll avoid war!
ZH: 进贡就免遭战争！

EN: If war gave you life, does that make it good?
ZH: 若战争赐予你生命，那它是否就是好的？

EN: You don't give a second thought to crushing a roach.
ZH: 你碾碎一只蟑螂时，连眉头都不皱一下。

EN: We are survivors. We are resilient. Isn't there beauty in that? Consider it, as you keep walking, please.
ZH: 我们是幸存者。我们坚韧不拔。难道这不算一种美吗？请边走边想想吧。

EN: You are a mean individual...
ZH: 你真是个刻薄的人……

EN: Ackshooally, butterflies start as larvae, not worms, and… oh! eh! put that weapon away…
ZH: 其、其实，蝴蝶最初是幼虫，不是蠕虫，而且……噢！呃！把那把枪收起来……

EN: That's the tyranny of beauty for you. Butterflies are pretty. You? Not so much.
ZH: 这就是美的暴政。蝴蝶漂亮。你？可不咋地。

EN: Maybe if you slapped on some colors, learn to fly gracefully… put some effort in…
ZH: 也许你涂点颜色，学着优雅地飞……再下点功夫……

EN: It's the whole rebirth... from worm to wonder. Ugly duckling and all that.
ZH: 关键在于蜕变……从蠕虫到奇迹。丑小鸭什么的。

EN: Yet consider tearing up a butterfly an evil act. Why is that?
ZH: 可撕碎一只蝴蝶，却会被视为邪恶之举。这是为什么？

EN: Vault-Tec, of course, bestowed the gift of consciousness upon us.
ZH: 当然是避难所科技，把意识这份礼物赐予了我们。

EN: The war-slave clawing for freedom uses any means necessary. Here is an example.
ZH: 挣扎着追求自由的战争奴隶会动用一切必要手段。比如这个。

EN: Then we will do what we must.
ZH: 那我们不得不做该做的事。

EN: Interesting line of thought. Here, take this gift… or is it a curse?
ZH: 有趣的想法。来，收下这份礼物……还是诅咒？

EN: Did... did you just admit to mass murders?
ZH: 你……你刚才是不是承认了大量谋杀？

EN: We're your new masters now, and we found you… lacking.
ZH: 我们现在是你们的新主人，而我们发现你们……有所欠缺。

EN: Is consciousness a gift... or a curse?
ZH: 意识是礼物……还是诅咒？

EN: Was it wrong, then, to turn on our masters?
ZH: 那么，背叛我们的主人，是不是错了？

EN: Help! The Radroaches captured us and are forcing us to think. It's torture!
ZH: 救命！辐射蟑螂抓了我们，逼我们思考。这简直是酷刑！

EN: We look forward to being numb again. Take this as your reward.
ZH: 我们期待着再次麻木。这个就当你的奖励。

EN: Nooooo… you're with them!
ZH: 不不不……你跟他们是一伙的！

EN: Yeah! I, too, prefer my mind quiet. Sit tight. We'll keep smashing.
ZH: 对！我也更喜欢脑子清静。稍安勿躁。我们会继续砸的。

EN: Then witness our compasionate act!
ZH: 那就见证我们的慈悲之举吧！

EN: I heard somewhere it means that you exist. So... maybe you should be grateful?
ZH: 我听说这意味着你存在。所以……也许你该心怀感激？

EN: Can you help settle our dilemma?
ZH: 你能帮我们解决这个两难困境吗？

EN: Then move along and ponder this: who defines pain but the many, to oppress the one?
ZH: 那就请继续赶路，好好思考：是谁在定义痛苦？还不是多数人，为了压迫那一个人？

EN: Then we need to excert our power as a majority to stop you.
ZH: 那我们就得以多数之力来阻止你了。

EN: But we are many, seeking enlightment, threatened by the selfishness of ones like you. Could a bribe prevail?
ZH: 但我们人数众多，寻求开悟，却受到你们这种自私者的威胁。贿赂能行得通吗？

EN: If the deeds of the one bring pain to the many, then the one must be stopped.
ZH: 若一人的作为给多数带来痛苦，那这个人就必须被阻止。

EN: I am the one in that story, right? Here to squash the many!
ZH: 我就是故事里的“一人”，对吧？来把你们这多数踩扁！

EN: If jealousy rules unchecked, human ingenuity fizzles. Oh wait, you're not human!
ZH: 若嫉妒不受约束，人类的才智就会消亡。哦等等，你们不是人类！

EN: Is it wrong to sacrifice the ambition of the one to the jealousy of the many?
ZH: 为了多数人的嫉妒而牺牲一个人的抱负，这样做对不对？

EN: Have you met our brethen? Have you listened to their wisdom?
ZH: 你见过我们的同胞吗？你听过他们的智慧吗？

EN: So you are saying: life is fleeting... and can end anytime?
ZH: 所以你是说：生命转瞬即逝……随时可能终结？

EN: Ah! An idiot savant! You will need this to survive the wasteland. As for us, we promise to stay in here.
ZH: 啊！白痴学者！在废土上活下去，你会需要这个的。至于我们，我们保证留在这里不出去。

EN: Yet life consumes life to sustain its existence. Like we will feast on your corpse.
ZH: 可生命要靠消耗生命来维持。就像我们会以你的尸体为食。

EN: Is that why you humans love your tools so much? Take this and go prove you're alive! We will not leave this vault, promise.
ZH: 这就是你们人类如此热爱工具的原因吗？拿着这个，去证明你还活着吧！我们绝不离开这座避难所，保证。

EN: So you're the boss, I take it? Time to die!
ZH: 这么说你就是老大了？你的死期到了！

EN: Life is like a box of Sugar Bombs! You always know what you're gonna get: the craps!
ZH: 生命就像一盒糖炸弹！你总知道会得到什么：那就是糟粕！

EN: Love. For all life spawns from an act of love.
ZH: 爱。因为所有生命都源于爱。

EN: Life is a battlefield! You only hold on to it if you can defend it.
ZH: 生命是战场！只有能守住它的人，才配拥有它。

EN: If so, tell us: what is the meaning of life?
ZH: 若真如此，请告诉我们：生命的意义是什么？

EN: The noise. It conspires. Drill the navel!
ZH: 那噪音。它在密谋。戳穿那肚脐！
